newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: J.Martins readies investment in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: J.Martins readies investment in Hungary.

text.p: Portuguese retailer Jeronimo Martins e Filho-SGPS is negotiating to buy a chain of six cash-and-carry stores in Hungary, its president Alexandre Soares dos Santos was quoted as saying.
He told Lisbon newspaper Diario de Noticias in an interview that the group was also seeking investment opportunities in Latin America.

He said Jeronimo Martins had ambitious plans for its drinking water business following its recent acquisition of sparking water group Vidago, Melgaco e Pedras Salgadas, including the opening of new distribution channels.
Jeronimo Martins also planned to expand its Lillywhites sports goods chain, he said.
